Today's selection covers 85 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 47 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Engineer Secretly Recorded Dozens of Meetings, Prosecutors Say
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Call center operator gets 8 years for helping scam 30,000 Americans
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 64 articles published in the last 24 hours
